messages.subject: Error message
parts:
Hi ,

I got the error message in the following.
Please let me know if anyone who know how to solve it.

Thank you.

> library(INLA)
> formula <- Petal.Length ~  1 + Petal.Width
> output <- inla(formula, family="gaussian", data=iris)

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error message
parts:
Seems like you have installed 3.5 version of INLA while you run R version 3.4. They are not compatible

--
Håvard Rue
Helpdesk
he...@r-inla.org
